reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the box, so I would scan it and check the report before buying. A named ISO 17025 lab with a per-batch report is more than most no-review brands give me, and the sachets fit my gym bag and car, so I would try one box.
objection: Zero reviews, and a lab report is not the same as NSF or USP certification. A brand can pick its own lab and publish only what it likes, so I would want the report to show real numbers and match the batch on my sachet.
would_change_my_mind: A report that opens from the QR with the actual magnesium and heavy-metal numbers for that batch, or some verified reviews. I would not rebuy without those.
